prompt: how do large language models like ChatGPT work

plan.title: How ChatGPT Works: It Just Predicts the Next Word
plan.description: Large language models like ChatGPT generate answers by predicting one word at a time. This video explains training on text, patterns, and why the results can sound smart but still be wrong.

beats.narration: ChatGPT does not look up answers. It guesses the next word, over and over, so fast that it feels like thinking.

props.text: It guesses the next word. Over and over.

beats.narration: First, it reads a huge amount of text. It learns which words tend to follow which, and how ideas connect across whole sentences.
Then you ask a question. The model picks a likely next word, adds it, and repeats. Word by word, an answer appears.
That means it can sound confident and still be wrong. It predicts what sounds right. So check anything that matters.

props.text: It predicts what sounds right, not what is true.
